notes: All 222 records with transaction calldata are retained verbatim as JSON values; 178 quote-request failures are excluded.

Expected amounts were independently read from Solidity packed fields (Magpie), SwapProxy ingress/native wrapping, split-route amounts, and terminal SWEEP/UNWRAP or V4 output bounds (Uni). They are not generated by the decoder under test.
Arc ERC20 USDC amounts use the 6-to-18 decimal scale when represented as native USDC; sub-6-decimal quote dust is not invented as a swap amount.
Magpie families describe only the outer calldata format consumed by this parser. No claim is made about the opaque payload's internal DEX choices, hop count or split topology.
Magpie confirmed its current quote API uses DexAggregator only; deprecated MagpieRouter formats are outside the local decoder's coverage requirements.

Records 548 and 562 have independently specified intended outputs and a historical knownFailure diagnosis. Every record must decode successfully and match expected fields; diagnostic markers never turn parser errors into passing tests.
These tests assert calldata decoding only. They do not compare against the selected UI account, call the quote backend, or assert onchain execution success.
